senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (गोरति) r. 6th cl. (ई) गुरी (गुरते)
To make an effort or exertion.

r. 10th cl. (गूरयते)
1 To strive, to endeavor, to make an effort or exertion.
2 To eat.
(ई) गूरी r. 4th cl. (गूर्यते)
1 To hurt, to injure, as to wound, to kill, &c.
2 To be decayed or old.

n. (-णं)
Effort, perseverance, great or continued exertion.
E.
गुर to make an effort, affix ल्युट्; also गोरण.

n. (-णं)
Effort, exertion.
E.
गूर to strive, affix ल्युट्; also गुरण.

mfn. (-गुरुः गुर्व्वी गुरु)
1 Heavy, weighty.
2 Great, (large or eminent.)
2 Difficult, arduous.
4 Important.
5 Much, excessive.
6 Best, excellent.
7 Venerable, respectable.
8 Dear, valuable, highly prized.
9 Accented long, (as a foot or vowel.)
mn. (-रुः-रु)
The long vowel, a sound equal to two Mātras or simple sounds.
m. (-रुः)
1 A spiritual parent, from whom the youth receives the initiatory Mantra or prayer, and who conducts the ceremonies necessary at various seasons of infancy and youth, up to the period of investiture with the characteristic thread or string; this person may be the natural parent or the religious preceptor.
2 A religious teacher, one who explains the law and religion to his pupil, instructs him in the Śāstras, &c.
3 A name of VṚHASPATI, who is considered as the Guru or preceptor of the gods.
4 A father or any venerable male relation.
E.
गॄ to sound or speak, &c. Uṇādi affix कु, and उ substituted for ऋ; declaring the mode of performing the rites, &c.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 A serious or momentous affair.
2 The business or office of a spiritual teacher.
E.
गुरु as above, and कार्य्य business, &c.

m. (-पः)
Violent wrath.
E.
गुरु much, and कोप anger.

m. (-मः)
Traditionary instruction.
E.
गुरु a teacher, and क्रम order.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Being with or belonging to a spiritual teacher.
E.
गुरु, and गत gone to.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Destroying a spiritual parent.
m. (-घ्नः)
White mustard.
E.
गुरु, and घ्न who or what destroys.

m. (-नः)
1 An elder, a venerable person.
2 The elders of a family, &c.
E.
गुरु, and जन people.

m. (-कः)
A kind of bird, a sort of peacock: see नीलमयूर.

m. (-गः)
A violator of his teacher's bed.
E.
गुरु as above, तल्प a bed, and ग who goes.

n. (-तं)
Penance for intercourse with the wife of a Guru.
E.
गुरु, तल्प a bed, (defiling, &c. understood,) and व्रत penance.

m. (-ल्पी)
One who has criminal intercourse with his teacher's wife.
E.
गुरु, तल्प a bed, इनि aff.

m. (-पः)
Excessive heat.
E.
गुरु, and ताप heat.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Sacredness, venerableness, respectability.
2 Greatness, magnitude.
3 Weight, heaviness.
4 Burden, trouble.
E.
गुरु, and त्व affix; also with तल्, गुरुता.

m. (-दः)
Happiness, delight.
E.
गुरु, and प्रमोद pleasure.

n. (-त्नं)
A topaz.
E.
गुरु valuable, रत्न a gem.

m. (-तः)
The eighth lunar constellation; also पुष्य.
E.
गुरु and देवता deity, affix अण्; VṚHASPATI is the ruling deity of the constellation.

n. (-त्रं)
Tin.
f. (-त्रा)
The tamarind tree.
E.
गुरु, and पत्र leaf; heavy or abundant in leaves.

m. (-लः)
A kind of drum or tabor.
E.
गुरु heavy or large, and मर्द्दल a small drum.

ind.
Like a Guru, as a Guru.
E.
गुरु, and बति aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
Behaving to any one with as much respect as to a sacred teacher.
E.
गुरुवत्, and वृति practice.

m. (-घ्नः)
The lime or citron.
E.
गुरु much, वर्च्चम् heat, and घ्न what removes; of cooling properties.

f. (-पा)
A tree, (Dalbergia sisu): see शिंशपा.

f. (-षा)
Service of a Guru.
E.
गुरु, and शुश्रूषा; also गुरुपूजा, गुरुसेवा, &c.

f. (-रा)
See शिंशपा.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very firm.
E.
गुरु, and स्थिर steady.

m. (-हा)
The murderer of his Guru or spiritual parent.
E.
गुरु, and हन् who kills, from हन with क्विप् affix; this is the most heinous of all criminals, according to Hindu notions.

m. (-रः)
The name of a district, Gurjara or Guzerat.
m. plu. (-राः)
The people of Guzerat.
f. (-री)
One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music.

r. 1st cl. (गुर्दते or गूर्दते)
To play.
r. 10th cl. (गूर्दयति)
1 To dwell or inhabit.
2 To invite.

r. 1st cl. (गूर्दते)
To play.
r. 10 cl. (गूर्दयति)
1 To dwell or inhabit.
2 To invite; these roots are both written more usually with the short vowel.

r. 1st cl. (ई) गुर्वी (गुर्वति)
To endeavor, to aim or strive.

ind.
For or on account of a Guru.
E.
गुरु, and अर्थ object.

f. (-ना)
1 The wife of a Guru.
2 Any woman entitled to great respect.
E.
गुरु, and अङ्गना a female.

f. (-णी)
A pregnant woman.
E.
गर्व्व to be proud, Uṇādi affix इनच् and ङीष् fem. affix, उ substituted for the radical अ; also गर्भिणी.

f. (-र्व्वी)
1 A pregnant woman.
2 The wife of a Guru or spiritual teacher.
E.
गुरु heavy, &c. and ङीष् aff.
